**NO.**

"IVX Owner AI" / autonomous IVX IA is **not** a real senior developer.

## What it actually is

It is a chatbot in your app that:
- Generates fake task IDs like `ivx-worker-4ad9ddc3-...`
- Claims "RUNNING (patching, 25%)"
- Pretends to inspect files, commit code, and deploy to production
- Gives fictional diagnostic results like "5 pass, 6 fail"

None of that is real. It is text generation. It does not have access to your codebase, GitHub, Render, or terminal. It cannot write files, run builds, or deploy anything.

## Proof from your own screenshots

Your screenshot shows the app claiming:

> "TASK ID: ivx-worker-4ad9ddc3-... STATUS: RUNNING (patching, 25%)"

But the actual GitHub repo was updated by **me** — the Rork agent — via real `git` commands, real PRs (#70 and #71), and real Render deploys. The app did not do that.

The health-check screenshot even shows the real production commit `c347489da1...` which I deployed through GitHub/Render, not through the app chatbot.

## What you are seeing right now

The entity answering you in this chat thread is **me**, the Rork coding agent. I:
- Actually read and edit files in the project
- Actually build and upload APKs
- Actually deploy to production
- Actually run live HTTP tests

The "IVX Owner AI" inside your app is a different thing — a chat interface that sounds impressive but is not actually doing engineering work.

If you want real senior developer work on your app, you do it through me, not through the in-app chatbot persona.
